h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Hazaribagh

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Hazaribagh

c: Hazaribagh sits on the Chota Nagpur plateau, and its milder summers make the town a good place to use an outdoor gym for more of the year than the plains below. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment to schools, colleges, housing colonies, lakeside walking areas and municipal parks in Hazaribagh. Our machines are made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,380 km away, and travel to Jharkhand by road.

With more comfortable weather, people tend to stay longer at the gym, so it helps to give them a full circuit rather than two or three machines. A circuit of five or six stations along a path covers legs, arms, waist and a cardio round. The machines are set in place by our installation crew or a regional dealer. Send us the length of your walking path and photos. We will plan the circuit on a layout drawing with the clear space marked.

items.q: How many machines make a good circuit?
items.a: Five or six stations cover the whole body for most users. Order them from warm-up to strength to a cool-down machine, and leave clear space between each one.

items.q: Can outdoor gym equipment be installed near a lake?
items.a: Yes. We check the ground first, since soil near water is often soft. The base is grouted deeper where needed, and the area should drain well after rain.

items.q: Do you supply outdoor gyms in Hazaribagh?
items.a: Yes. We dispatch from our factory in Vasai by road and install through our own team or a dealer in eastern India, as per the approved layout.
